title: Standard Notifications/Alerts that sound only ONCE
body:
**Problem**:
I have specific sounds for each alert. Sometimes, I'm working and an alert fires. Maybe I'm holding my baby, maybe I'm putting a kid to sleep, maybe I'm digging a hole or doing the dishes or in a meeting. I would like to hear that alert, but I don't want to hear it forever. Sometimes I can't get to my phone, unlock it, navigate to the app, press down volume, then go to the menu, click snooze, click the time, etc. 

It takes 5 steps to silence an alert-
1. Unlock Phone
2. Open App
3. Click Menu
4. Select Snooze Alert
5. Select Snooze Duration

Any diabetic will tell you that being able to quickly silence an alert is very important. Generally, when an alert fires, I want my phone to STFU as quickly as possible. 

**Desired Solution-**
Option for an alert to play an alert sound ONCE (Like every other GD notification that ever was on any phone, including those amber alerts)
Bonus- Choose how many times the sound plays before automatically silencing. 

**Alternatives I've considered-**
1. Ditching X Drip (But nothing is better)
2. Chucking my phone against a wall (But anger towards inanimate objects is pointless)
3. Making a 10 minute alert tone that has like 2 beeps up front followed by 9:55 worth of silence.
4. Pre-snoozing alerts. 

#1 and 2 are not acceptable. 
#3 is a viable alternative, but it's such a stupid way to fix a problem that shouldn't even be a problem. 
#4 kinda defeats the purpose of an alert. If I knew it was going to happen, I wouldn't need it to happen in the first place.
